lines: Who's doing what, and are we on track? Make the plan together.
The Plan tab opens on the plan board: Backlog, To do, Doing and Done, each with its stories and its points.
The sprint chip says twenty-four points left, seven behind.
New story asks what needs doing, where it goes, how big it is, who's on it, and a tag.
Add it, and it lands in To do.
Open a story to change it, move it on or mark it done.
Mark the cabin done, and it moves to Done with a tick.
When someone else adds a story, your open board shows it, without a reload.
The burn-down shows the points left each day against the ideal line.
At this week's pace, the plan finishes on September thirtieth, four days late.
Beside the chart, the biggest stories still open.
The Popkin home shows the plan at a glance, and the recap counts the stories done.

lines.text: On a phone, one column at a time, swiped sideways, with New story floating.
On a desktop, all four columns side by side.

lines: Plan has a switch. While it is off, the tab is gone and its screens say so. Nothing is lost.
What no screen shows: only whoever added a story, its owner or the Host may delete it, and a wrapped-up Popkin's plan is read only.
Every open board follows each change, live.
That is journey twenty-one. Popkin is a platform for pop-up communities.
